What we do

General dentistry, done carefully.

01Cleanings & exams

Routine and Airflow cleanings, gentle on teeth and gums.

02Fillings

Tooth-colored, made to blend in.

03Crowns, inlays & onlays

Custom-made to restore a damaged tooth.

04Root canal therapy

Out of pain, and you keep your tooth.

05Gum care

Perio Protect trays treat gum disease at home.

06Dentures

Full and partial, made to look natural.

07Clear aligners

Straighter teeth without metal braces.

08Dental implants

Replace missing teeth, including All-on-4.

Why Luca
More
Less dentistry.

Not many dentists will say it. We look for the root cause, so problems stop before they start.

  • 3D imaging and digital scans, no messy molds
  • A prevention plan made for you (LUCAcare)
  • IV sedation available for longer visits
Your first visit

Three steps, no surprises.

1Request a time

Send the form or call. We call back during office hours.

2We get the full picture

Digital scans, 3D imaging and photos, so nothing is guessed.

3A plan you understand

What needs doing now, what can wait, and what it costs.

Insurance and cost

Do you take my insurance?

We are out of network with insurance plans. We help you submit claims to your insurance company, and we have LUCAcare membership plans and Cherry financing.

Privacy Policy

Privacy Policy


Effective Date: 1/1/2025

At Luca Aesthetic, your privacy is important to us. This Privacy Policy outlines how we collect, use, and protect the information you provide when using our website.

Information We Collect

We may collect the following types of information when you visit our website or contact us:

  • Name, phone number, email address, and any other information you submit via contact forms
  • Information related to appointment requests or service inquiries
  • Non-personal information such as browser type, device, IP address, and pages visited (used for analytics purposes)

How We Use Your Information

We use the information we collect to:

  • Respond to your questions or appointment requests
  • Improve our website and services
  • Send occasional updates or reminders, if you’ve opted in to receive them

We do not sell, rent, or share your personal information with third parties for marketing purposes.

How We Protect Your Information

We use appropriate technical and administrative measures to protect your information from unauthorized access or disclosure. However, no method of transmission over the internet is completely secure.

Third-Party Links

Our website may contain links to third-party websites. We are not responsible for the privacy practices or content of those sites.

Your Choices

You may choose to limit or opt out of future contact from us at any time. If you have submitted personal information and would like it deleted or corrected, please contact us.

Updates to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted here with a new effective date.

Contact Us

If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or how your information is handled, please contact:
